title: each command of a line is judged on its own: a commit message, a search or a heredoc that only names a harness, a jitso command or an Orca verb passes beside other commands
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, section "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories" (the guard denies only what starts an agent)
intent: A line that lexes is judged command by command, so a command that is not a data command (git add, cd, a shell) no longer removes the quotes of the others. A data command (git commit or tag, orca orchestration send, ask or reply, gh pr, issue or release create, edit or comment, echo, printf, cat that reads a heredoc) has its quoted text and heredoc bodies masked; any other command is judged by its program and its words.

values: git add . && git commit -m "fix (claude) x" -- a
git add a && git commit -m "chore: set up (jitso init) here" -- a
cd x && git commit -m "docs: orchestration worker-start is denied"
git status; gh pr create --title "x" --body "run orca orchestration dispatch"

git add . && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
fix (claude): orca agent launch
EOF

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix (claude) x
EOF
)" && git push
